name: PT Chemstar Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Chemstar Indonesia Tbk manufactures and trades in chemicals for the textile and other industries in Indonesia. The company offers DEMULGEN RA-AC, an acid-reduction clearing agent for dispersing dyes; ESKA FINISH FN-GRM, a weight-enhancer agent for cotton and polyester knitted; ESKALET DA-APC, a chelating and dispersing agent; ESKA PLUS DN-SR, a sodium alkali for the fixation of reactive dyes in exhaust dyeing; ESKA SOFT SN-HWA, a micro emulsion silicone type softening agent for natural fibers and related blend; and ESKA FIX FC-DR, a fixing agent for direct and reactive dyes to improve fastness of the dyed or printed materials made from cellulose fiber and their blended.
